result.instructions: Tools for TinyURL, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "How many short links do I have in my account?"; "Show the short links I created this month with their destinations."; "How many clicks did my short link spring-sale get this month?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes TinyURL data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run tinyurl_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run tinyurl_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run tinyurl_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. tinyurl_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: tinyurl_get_link
tools.title: Get a short link
tools.description: Details of one short link: destination URL, tiny_url, tags, created/expires dates, archived/deleted flags, analytics settings, total hits and owner. GET /alias/{domain}/{alias}.

domain.description: The short link's domain: tinyurl.com (default) or one of the account's branded domains.

alias.description: The alias, the part after the domain: https://tinyurl.com/<alias>.

tools.name: tinyurl_list_links
tools.title: List short links
tools.description: List the account's short links (type available = active, archived = archived), optionally created within a date range or filtered by alias or tag. The TinyURL API does not page this list: at most `limit` items (default 50, max 200) are returned together with the total, so narrow with from/to/search when truncated is true. GET /urls/{type}.

type.description: available = active links, archived = archived links.

from.description: Only links created after this ISO 8601 date or date-time.

to.description: Only links created before this ISO 8601 date or date-time.

tools.name: tinyurl_count_links
tools.title: Count short links
tools.description: How many short links the account has (active or archived), optionally within a creation date range or filtered by alias or tag. GET /urls/{type}/count.

type.description: available = active links, archived = archived links.

from.description: Only links created after this ISO 8601 date or date-time.

to.description: Only links created before this ISO 8601 date or date-time.

tools.name: tinyurl_get_analytics
tools.title: Get click analytics
tools.description: Aggregated click analytics for the account, or for one link (alias) or one tag, from a start date. report: timeline (clicks over time; interval minute/hour/day/week/month), general (browsers, operating systems, devices), weekday and hour (popularity), top_sources (referrers), top_languages, location (countries, or the regions of one country via region = ISO 3166 alpha-2 code). Which reports are available depends on the account's TinyURL plan. Visitor-level raw logs are not exposed. GET /analytics/*.

from.description: Start of the report, ISO 8601 date or date-time (required).

alias.description: Only this short link, written domain/alias, e.g. tinyurl.com/myalias.

region.description: location report only: world (default, lists countries) or a country code such as US (lists its regions).

tools.name: tinyurl_create_link
tools.title: Create a short link
tools.description: WRITE: create ONE new short link for an http(s) destination URL. Optional custom alias (5-30 characters on tinyurl.com), domain (tinyurl.com or a branded domain), tags, expiry and description. Not idempotent: calling it again without an alias creates another link. Returns the new tiny_url. POST /create.

url.description: The long destination URL (absolute, http:// or https://).

domain.description: Domain for the new link: tinyurl.com (default) or one of the account's branded domains.

alias.description: Custom alias (5-30 characters on tinyurl.com, 1+ on a branded domain). A random one is generated when omitted.

tags.description: Tags to group the link (each up to 45 characters).

expires_at.description: ISO 8601 expiry; omit or null for a link that never expires.

anyOf.description: ISO 8601 date-time (or a duration such as P10DT4H).

description.description: Internal description of the link (3-1000 characters).

tools.name: tinyurl_update_link
tools.title: Update a short link's alias, tags or settings
tools.description: WRITE: change an existing short link's alias, tags, expiry, description or click-analytics switch. At least one new_* field is required. DESTRUCTIVE for what it replaces: new_tags REPLACES all existing tags, and renaming the alias (new_alias) makes the old short URL stop working. The destination URL is changed with tinyurl_change_destination. PATCH /update.

domain.description: The short link's domain: tinyurl.com (default) or one of the account's branded domains.

new_alias.description: New alias (5-30 characters on tinyurl.com). The old short URL stops working.

new_tags.description: The complete new tag list; replaces the existing tags (an empty list removes them).

new_expires_at.description: New ISO 8601 expiry; null = never expires.

anyOf.description: ISO 8601 date-time (or a duration such as P10DT4H).

annotations.title: Update a short link's alias, tags or settings

tools.name: tinyurl_change_destination
tools.title: Change a short link's destination URL
tools.description: WRITE: point an existing short link at a new destination. DESTRUCTIVE: everyone who opens the short link is sent to the new URL from now on and the old destination is overwritten. The new URL must be http(s). PATCH /change.

domain.description: The short link's domain: tinyurl.com (default) or one of the account's branded domains.

url.description: The new destination URL (absolute, http:// or https://).

annotations.title: Change a short link's destination URL

tools.name: tinyurl_set_link_archived
tools.title: Archive or unarchive a short link
tools.description: WRITE: archive an active short link (archived = true) or restore an archived one (archived = false). Archiving moves the link to the archived list; nothing is deleted and it can be restored. The API's archive endpoint is a toggle, so the link's current state is read first and nothing is changed when it already matches, and the state afterwards is checked. Do not run two archive calls for the same link at once. GET /alias/{domain}/{alias}, then PATCH /archive.

domain.description: The short link's domain: tinyurl.com (default) or one of the account's branded domains.

alias.description: The alias, the part after the domain: https://tinyurl.com/<alias>.

archived.description: true = archive the link, false = unarchive it.

annotations.title: Archive or unarchive a short link
